title: Harden public m2-gateway Cloud Run deployment
description: The public m2-gateway receives its gateway password as a literal environment variable, runs Flask with debug mode enabled, and uses the Booktracker project default Compute Engine identity with broad Editor/admin roles. Rotate the credential, deploy it through Secret Manager, disable debug mode, assign a dedicated minimal runtime identity, add request/auth tests, and verify production logs do not expose request secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Rotated password is a Secret Manager reference; Flask debug is off; service uses a dedicated least-privilege identity; unauthorized requests fail closed; logs contain no secret material; cold deployment smoke test passes.
